title: Hotel booking confirmation
description: Confirm a hotel reservation on WhatsApp with dates, room type and booking reference. Utility template for hotels and travel agencies.
notes: Include check-in and check-out dates and a reference; booking details are the clearest utility signal.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your stay at *{{hotel}}* is confirmed. Check-in is on {{checkin}} and check-out on {{checkout}}, in a {{room}} room. Your booking reference is {{booking_ref}}. We look forward to hosting you!
